gapNote: The official F1 profile lists his teams and career totals but says nothing about the 2026 Haas situation. The Race gives the fullest account of the Haas breakdown but most of the team criticism comes from unnamed sources, which the page must attribute as such. Ocon's own statement about the Mexico City removal could not be verified (RACER returned HTTP 429 and no other fetched source quotes it), so the page leaves it out. Haas has not given a reason for the removal; the team said he was not ill.
